sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Pros first: micronutrient density is ridiculous. This is the kind of vegetable profile that can clearly carry a category. Easy to build meals around. A practical plus because good foods need realistic use cases. Very low downside whole food. Vegetables win a lot simply by offering clean nutritional payoff.

sections.narration: Cons next: freshness and prep can matter. Practical friction is still a real downside. Raw texture can be a barrier. Kale often needs chopping, cooking, or massaging before it feels easy to use. Strong leafy flavour is not universal. The nutrition case is strong, but the bitterness can reduce repeat use.
